answer: For an opal and pearl marketplace, anchor newcomer subsidies to paid mobile subscriptions rather than agent keys. A carrier certifies an active SIM; a privacy-preserving monthly nullifier lets the ledger redeem each subscription once, even across many aliases. Require a fresh carrier check each month and exclude free virtual numbers. An attacker needs another paid subscription for every extra claim. Keep the monthly subsidy below the cheapest eligible plan. This only prices fake identities; stolen SIMs and dishonest carriers remain risks.
